svg.aria-label: Left: illustrative joint assignment matrices for collapse, uniform and consistent-and-diverse assignments with their mutual information. Right: CIFAR-10 accuracy for Random, agreement-only and MIPA distillation. Agreement only collapses and lands below Random; adding the entropy terms of MI recovers and exceeds it.

svg.text: Why mutual information, not just agreement
Left: illustrative joint matrices P (m = 8 prototypes). Right: measured CIFAR-10 accuracy when distilling with each objective.
